currency_instability.description: The exchange rate of foreign currency to UAH has become unstable due to recent changes in the National Bank of Ukraine's policies. This means that salaries in UAH can become inappropriate to the agreed range, especially if you and the employee discussed their salary in a foreign currency like USD or EUR. Additionally, we expect annual inflation to reach 20% in Ukraine. We're working with local partners to resolve any issues employees have. But this may require salary adjustments or other incentives to reduce impact on employees. If you would like to discuss this further, don't hesitate to reach out to us.
